title: Answer: affect is the elemental experience, perception and thought derive from it

statements.text: Experience in its elemental form is affect, the felt state of the subject, and it is basic. Perceptual and cognitive experience is derived: cortical functions are unconscious in themselves and borrow their consciousness from the brainstem.

sources.quote: it identifies the elemental form of consciousness as affect
derive their consciousness absolutely from the centrencephalic region
